That's a pretty strong take. Why do you think the current system is failing so fundamentally?

The current system is failing because it is fundamentally rigged in favor of entrenched special interests, not the average citizen. The political class has become completely disconnected from the reality of working people, prioritizing corporate profits and donor influence over genuine public welfare. This systemic corruption ensures that the status quo, which benefits the wealthy elite, remains untouched.
